title: All 15 Webots CI scenarios pass — GPU browser streaming optimization merged
summary: This CI run tested the merge of PR #144 (feat/webots-gpu-browser-streaming) into dev. All 15 scenarios passed (100% rate), covering builtin file operations, plan control, camera/lidar snapshots, explore, mapping, memory, speech, voiceprint, scene object listing, fault recovery, object navigation, and patrol observe. The change set introduces an optimized browser streaming pipeline with a viewer server, stream proxy, and keepalive script to reduce bandwidth and improve remote viewing.
pr_changes: Added viewer_server.py to serve WebotsView locally and proxy/cache remote viewer and world assets.
Added webots_stream_proxy.py to forward the live W3D stream while dropping unused robot-window camera payloads.
Added webots_stream_keepalive.py to keep externally controlled Webots simulations broadcasting at real-time speed.
Modified entrypoint.sh to launch the new viewer server, stream proxy, and keepalive scripts instead of the simple HTTP server.
Modified Dockerfile to copy the new Python scripts and install websockets dependency.
Modified compose.stream.yaml to expose the optimized stream port (default 1235) and set environment variables for the proxy.
Modified start.sh to reflect the new stream port and viewer port in log messages.
Updated README.md with documentation for the new streaming architecture, SSH forwarding example, and port override variables.
test_result: All 15 scenarios passed: 4 builtin (fault_recovery_builtin, file_roundtrip, plan_control_builtins, run_command), 8 cap (camera_snapshot, explore_smoke, lidar_snapshot, mapping_save, memory_roundtrip, scene_object_fixture, speech_speak, voiceprint_list), and 3 flow (fault_recovery, object_navigation, patrol_observe). The CI exercised 20 capabilities across the system.
suggested_fix: No fix needed. Monitor the new streaming components (viewer_server.py, webots_stream_proxy.py, webots_stream_keepalive.py) for any edge-case failures in production.
risks_or_watchouts: The scene service's LLM enrichment (fake-vlm) consistently returns empty JSON, causing repeated JSONDecodeError warnings. This does not affect test pass/fail but indicates the fake VLM endpoint may need attention.
The rtabmap visualization (rtabmap_viz) fails to create a drawable due to missing DRI3 support in the headless Xorg environment. This is cosmetic and does not affect mapping functionality.
The nav2 velocity_guard crashes on shutdown with an RCLError (invalid context). This is a known ROS2 lifecycle issue and does not affect test results.
